issues.where: the globe and base across the shake frames (78/1.30 s and 156/2.60 s)
issues.what: the globe never moves during the shake: outline, base and reflection are pixel-stable in every frame, with no lift, no tilt and no displacement; the shake is conveyed only by the interior fogging up, so the globe reads as weightless and untouched rather than a heavy thing in a hand
issues.fix: physically move the globe during the shake: a lift with effort, unequal strokes with sharp reversals and a tilt that lags, then a set down that lands and settles

issues.where: frames 78 and 156, the whole sphere interior
issues.what: the snow storm is a uniform milky whiteout that fills the sphere evenly from edge to edge, reading as an opacity fade; there is no lag behind the glass, no slam and no folding storm structure
issues.fix: stage the liquid response: particles stream behind the moving glass, slam against the far wall, fold into a turbulent storm, then turn as one slow whirl

issues.where: the clearing frames 236/3.93 s through 392/6.53 s
issues.what: the fog clears as a global fade across the whole sphere at once rather than snow falling and settling downward; visibility returns everywhere simultaneously
issues.fix: clear the storm top-down with particles descending at different rates and coming to rest on the cabin roof, tree and ground

issues.where: the interior across the at-rest run, e.g. 444/7.40 s vs 496/8.27 s
issues.what: the tree and window glow shift in brightness and saturation between frames, reading as flicker in the small lights during what should be a steady settled state
issues.fix: lock interior lighting and material response once the globe is at rest

issues.where: the interior across several seconds at rest (288/4.80 s to 574/9.57 s)
issues.what: almost no perceptible particle drift between frames; the settled globe looks near frozen instead of snow drifting and falling slowly at many depths
issues.fix: keep slow, depth-varied falling and drifting snow at rest, with particles settling on surfaces they meet
